title: Best Gyms in Wellington 2026 — CBD, Hutt Valley, and Kapiti
meta_desc: Compare Wellington gym memberships, prices and contracts. Find the best gym in CBD, Hutt Valley, and Kapiti
intro: Wellington's gym landscape offers a range of options, from Les Mills to boutique studios. With prices starting from $15.95 per week, there's something for every budget. We've compared the top gyms in Wellington to help you make an informed decision.

sections.heading: City-Centre Gym Options
sections.body: The Wellington CBD is home to a number of gym options, including Les Mills, City Fitness, and Anytime Fitness. These gyms offer a range of equipment, classes, and personal training services.

sections.heading: Les Mills vs Alternative Gyms
sections.body: Les Mills is a popular choice in Wellington, with three locations in the city. However, alternative gyms like City Fitness and Anytime Fitness offer similar services at a lower price point. For example, Les Mills costs $29.95 per week, while City Fitness costs $24.95 per week.

sections.heading: Hutt Valley Gym Options
sections.body: The Hutt Valley has a number of gym options, including Les Mills, Jetts, and Snap Fitness. These gyms offer a range of equipment, classes, and personal training services.
list: Les Mills Hutt City: $29.95 per week, 12 month contract
Jetts Lower Hutt: $14.95 per week, no contract
Snap Fitness Upper Hutt: $19.95 per week, 6 month contract

sections.heading: Kapiti Gym Options
sections.body: The Kapiti region has a number of gym options, including Les Mills, Anytime Fitness, and Core Fitness. These gyms offer a range of equipment, classes, and personal training services.

sections.heading: Getting Started with Your New Gym
sections.body: Once you've chosen a gym, it's time to get started. Be sure to read the contract terms and conditions carefully before signing up. You should also take a tour of the gym and meet with a personal trainer to discuss your fitness goals.
